inspections.title: Abuse prevention policies missing
inspections.detail: Develop and implement policies and procedures to prevent abuse, neglect, and theft.

inspections.detail: Verify that a nurse aide has been trained; and if they haven't worked as a nurse aide for 2 years, receive retraining.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Ensure that the resident and his/her doctor meet face-to-face at all required visits
inspections.detail: Ensure that the resident and his/her doctor meet face-to-face at all required visits.

inspections.title: Pharmacist drug review not done properly
inspections.detail: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

inspections.title: Medication error rate of 5% or more
inspections.detail: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.

inspections.title: Unnecessary psychiatric drugs (sedating medications)
inspections.detail: Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.

inspections.title: Suspected abuse or neglect not reported on time
inspections.detail: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Follow rules about disclosure of ownership requirements and tell the state agency about changes in ownership and/or administrative personnel
inspections.detail: Follow rules about disclosure of ownership requirements and tell the state agency about changes in ownership and/or administrative personnel.

inspections.title: No qualified infection-control staff
inspections.detail: Designate a qualified infection preventionist to be responsible for the infection prevent and control program in the nursing home.

inspections.title: Care plan incomplete
inspections.detail: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.

inspections.title: Care plan not updated on time
inspections.detail: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Medicare/Medicaid coverage notice not given
inspections.detail: Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.

inspections.title: Physical restraints used without medical need
inspections.detail: Ensure that each resident is free from the use of physical restraints, unless needed for medical treatment.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Pressure sores not prevented or treated
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

inspections.title: Family or doctor not told about a change or injury
inspections.detail: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.
